artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: The DB-i-5 record: script hash, household hash, the two listed calls with HTTP 400 each (no 2xx body, so no private response file), the three verdicts (a REFUSED, b NOT_RUN, c REFUSED), reads and the basis words. Counts, hashes and words only. The two POSTs went to the one Scope URL; no other vendor, AWS write, push or deploy.
The one probe script, hashed in the record. It holds no AWS write call, names no other firm, and makes no HTTP call except the Scope POST. Not deployed; it is run only from the worktree.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: `DBI117-1-AC1` -- the record is complete and carries no identifier; the script is a tracked file hashed as recorded, with no AWS write call and no other firm's name; the household equals the checker's recompute from the private dimension; 1 to 4 calls are listed with `calls_made` and `vendor_calls` equal to the count, each `ok` agreeing with its status, each 2xx response a private file hashed as recorded; `token_store_used` is within its enum and `secret_reads` is an integer within the call cap; the three verdicts and their counts equal the checker's recount from the saved response bodies by the rules above; no write to AWS, no push, no deploy. Base: FAIL (no record).
